mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (conversation_id, round_id, message_id, role, content, status, sources, provider, elapsed_ms, error_msg) VALUES (#{message.conversationId}, #{message.roundId}, #{message.messageId}, #{message.role}, #{message.content}, #{message.status}, CAST(#{message.sourcesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{message.provider}, #{message.elapsedMs}, #{message.errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, round_id, role, content, status, sources::text AS sources_json, provider, elapsed_ms, error_msg, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
